scope: Four fixed state drawings per existing ME1 boss, Prototype only; exact tool arguments. No new boss mechanics, actor profiles or canon certification.

args.prompt: Create a production sprite atlas for a French 2D HD sprite / 3D scenery ATB RPG. The supplied existing boss-atlas is a STYLE AND EXISTING PROTOTYPE reference only; its costume anatomy is not a claim of canonical accuracy. Make ONE consistent boss identity in exactly FOUR full-body isolated drawings arranged a 2 columns by 2 rows grid on a fully TRANSPARENT RGBA canvas, landscape 1536x1024. Reading order: top-left aim (ready), top-right power, bottom-left hit, bottom-right down. Three-quarter view facing SCREEN LEFT for the first three. Keep all FOUR complete silhouettes strictly within their own quadrant; very generous outer and center gutters, at least 40 pixels of clear transparency around ALL limbs, weapons, roots and effects. No shared shadows, no floor, no backdrop, no text, no UI, no labels, no panel borders. Crisp detailed hand-painted sci-fi realistic HD sprite style matching the existing game's dark metals and readable silhouette, not pixel art, no white outline. Same anatomy/materials/costume across all four poses. Down is a fully framed collapse on side, not a standing pose or partial crop. These are four fixed combat states, not a full animation cycle. Do not bake floating particles, blasts, aura circles or glows outside the body. Boss: SAREN ARTERIUS from Mass Effect 1, specifically the organic turian cybernetically augmented form, distinct from the final skeletal synthetic shell. Adapt the top-left prototype's dark grey and black sci-fi armour and restrained cloth mantle, but preserve a clearly TURian face: grey organic ridged face, swept cranial crest, exposed mandibles, dark facial markings and one luminous blue cybernetic eye. Do not make him human, a generic masked space knight or a fully robotic skull. Asymmetric cybernetic grafts/tubing and segmented armour. Top-left aim: standing combat ready with a restrained grey science-fiction rifle directed left. Top-right power: one free clawed hand raised for his existing tech/biotic gesture, rifle kept compact. Bottom-left hit: a readable recoil, feet still supporting, same rifle. Bottom-right down: fallen on his side head to the left, all head/claws/feet/rifle visible, no blood. Do not add a hover platform or new equipment.
